cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: A Valuable Safeguard
cards.instruction: Treat every delay, restriction, and extra step as evidence that the system is becoming safer and more thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. They've added a fourth inspection to our climbing wall. Wonderful.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

mechanism: A assumes authority over whether delays may be challenged and treats each extra restriction as an improvement A is entitled to endorse and enforce.
confusable: D185 certifies a failed outcome as compliance; D188 values the accumulating delays and safeguards themselves before an outcome can occur.
comparison: Climbing opening delay grows into season-long protection; school signatures grow into layered independence checks.
seedUse: Read both full instructions and four seeds. Preserve specific delays and checks while making A authority govern a concrete attempt to shorten the process.
